sources.label: Official Massimo Dutti product-page Body measurements (women's shirts, cm)

audit: Old URL dead. Body measurements tab on product pages: chest and hip only, no waist; UK 18 has no hip value. Shirts chart read on two shirts and used as the tops chart. Knit cardigan and dress body charts print a different chest (UK 8 86, 10 90, 12 96, 14 100, 16 104; no UK 18). Trousers chart prints hip only, same hip values. Old row M (UK 10-12) 89/69/94.
